sources.what: Official residential price plan page, read in the built-in browser 19 Oct (plan cards, w/GST and w/o GST)
Keppel plan feed the page loads; used only for FIXED24 Special (referral-only, not shown as a card)

plans.name: FIXED24

promo.title: Bill rebate + Maybank card rebate
promo.value: S$125 bill rebate + S$20 Maybank card rebate = up to S$145

plans.notes: Rate up from 29.00¢. Feed lists new fact sheet "Fact Sheet_FIXED24 v42 _2026 1019 Standard.pdf" (dated 19 Oct 2026).
plans.evidence: FIXED24 24 Months Fixed Rate 30.90¢/kWh (w/GST) Fixed Rate 28.35¢/kWh (w/o GST)

plans.name: FIXED24 Special

promo.title: Card + referral rebate
promo.value: S$20 card + S$25 referral = up to S$45

plans.notes: Referral-only plan, not shown as a card on the page; read from the plan feed. Rate up from 28.50¢. Fact sheet v5 dated 2026-10-19.

plans.name: FIXED36

promo.title: Bill rebate + Maybank card rebate
promo.value: S$100 bill rebate + S$20 Maybank card rebate = up to S$120

plans.notes: Rate up from 28.90¢. Feed lists fact sheet v17 dated 2026-10-19.
plans.evidence: FIXED36 36 Months Fixed Rate 30.63¢/kWh (w/GST) Fixed Rate 28.10¢/kWh (w/o GST)

plans.name: FIXED12
plans.evidence: FIXED12 12 Months Fixed Rate 31.15¢/kWh (w/GST) Fixed Rate 28.58¢/kWh (w/o GST)

plans.name: WEEKEND SAVER
plans.notes: Unchanged. (The feed's rateWithGST field still says 39.89 for peak; the page text says 39.90.)

plans.name: ecoGreen24

promo.title: Bill rebate + Maybank card rebate
promo.value: S$100 bill rebate (first 1,000) + S$20 Maybank card rebate = up to S$120

plans.evidence: ecoGreen24 24 Months Fixed Rate 38.80¢/kWh (w/GST) Fixed Rate 35.60¢/kWh (w/o GST)

issues: Keppel issued new fact sheets dated 19 Oct 2026 for FIXED24, FIXED24 Special and FIXED36: all three fixed rates rose by ~1.7–1.9¢.
